**Question: where and when to renew the israeli driving license?**

-my 2nd A5 year interview: May 14
-my driver's license expires: May 16 (in gov.il system), May 28 (on the license)

when i click [https://www.gov.il/en/service/driving_license_renewal](https://www.gov.il/en/service/driving_license_renewal) to renew now, it shows 15 nis, and only until August 28th this year. 

Where and when should i go for online renewing? Thanks!
